Here in Omaha, the changing seasons are no joke. One minute you’re enjoying a perfect spring day, and the next, your yard is covered in a blanket of helicopter seeds and fallen branches from a classic Nebraska thunderstorm. Then comes fall, and with it, an endless sea of leaves. It’s a constant battle to keep your property looking sharp. That’s where we come in. At A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service, we handle the heavy lifting of seasonal cleanups so you don’t have to. We’re not just a junk hauling company; we’re your neighbors, and we know exactly what your yard needs to look its best, no matter what the Nebraska weather throws at it.

Taming Your Yard After a Wild Nebraska Season

Whether it’s the aftermath of a harsh winter or the leafy explosion of fall, every season leaves its mark on your yard. Spring in the Omaha area means clearing away the last of the winter debris—fallen branches, dead leaves, and whatever else the snow was hiding. It’s the perfect time to get your lawn and garden beds ready for the growing season. A thorough spring cleanup gives your grass and plants the breathing room they need to thrive. We can even help with mulching to give your flower beds a fresh start.

Then there’s fall. The beautiful colors are great, but the cleanup can be a real chore, especially if you have a lot of mature trees in your neighborhood like those in Dundee or Benson. It’s not just about raking; it’s about getting all those leaves and twigs bagged up and hauled away. A good fall cleanup is also crucial for your lawn's health, preventing mold and fungus from growing under a thick layer of wet leaves. Let us handle the leaf removal and you can just enjoy the crisp autumn air.

What a Full Seasonal Cleanup Includes

When you call us for a seasonal cleanup, we’re thorough. We don’t just do a quick pass; we make sure your yard is truly ready for the next season. Here’s what our typical cleanup service looks like:

Debris and Leaf Clearing

We’ll clear all the accumulated leaves, twigs, and other organic debris from your lawn, garden beds, and walkways.

Hauling Away All Yard Waste

Unlike some services that leave bags by your curb, we haul everything away. Your yard is clean and the debris is gone, it’s that simple.

Trimming and Pruning

We’ll trim back perennials and prune shrubs as needed for the season to encourage healthy growth.

Final Mowing and Edging

For fall cleanups, we’ll give your lawn a final mow and edge, and for spring, we’ll get it ready for the first cut of the season.

More Than Just a Cleanup – It’s an Investment

Think of a seasonal cleanup as more than just a cosmetic fix. It’s an important part of maintaining the health and value of your property. A clean yard prevents pests from making a home in piles of debris and reduces the risk of lawn diseases. It also just feels good to have a tidy outdoor space you can be proud of, especially when you’re having friends over for a barbecue in your Papillion backyard.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a seasonal cleanup cost in Omaha?

It really depends on the size of your yard and how much debris there is. A small yard in a newer development might be on the lower end, while a large, heavily treed lot in an older neighborhood will cost more. We’ll give you a free, no-obligation estimate so you know the exact price upfront.

When is the best time for a spring or fall cleanup?

For spring, we recommend scheduling a cleanup as soon as the snow has melted and the ground has thawed, usually in March or April. For fall, the best time is after most of the leaves have fallen but before the first significant snowfall, typically in late October or November.

Do I need to be home for the cleanup service?

Nope, you don’t need to be home. As long as we have access to the areas we need to work on, we can get the job done and send you an invoice. We try to make it as easy as possible for you.

Do you haul the yard waste away?

Absolutely. We are a full-service junk removal company, so hauling is our specialty. We will load up all the leaves, branches, and other debris and take it with us, leaving your yard completely clean.
